digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle verification and policy enforcement
propositions: Rebar project must enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close configuration keys while library defaults remain false.

End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove material-pin and close-review enforcement gates reject invalid transitions and accept valid ones through public CLI surfaces with deterministic exit codes and reason tokens.

Natural transitive invalidation through depends_on and blocks references must normalize to a single canonical prerequisite and propagate only after material changes, not after unchanged successful re-review.
Execution-phase self-edits, return-to-open resets, and code-only drift at close must be proven through public lifecycle surfaces without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation events.
Enable, disable, and re-enable policy behavior, plus deleted/archived target handling and concurrent review/close changes, must be covered by lifecycle test scenarios.

Four fixture cases (legacy unpinned claim, current pins close, stale pin rejection, missing close-plan review rejection) must pass with exact exit codes and reason tokens recorded in structured JSON evidence.
